title: Critique: expander graphs have high integrated information

statements.text: Aaronson showed that simple 2D grids and expander graphs reach high values of integrated information though there are strong reasons to think they are not conscious, which casts doubt on integrated information as a mark of consciousness.

sources.quote: Much skepticism regarding IIT has resulted from demonstrations of high phi values being associated with systems for which there are strong a priori reasons to suspect a lack of consciousness
